**FOLLOW-UP (A2, out of scope): GitHub issue-link bash keeps hardcoded base=="main" — unify over ctx.defaultBranch when bash paths migrate to Node**

What: Registered during A2 Phase 2 (issue-link parity gap ruling). The GitHub governance.yml issue-link BASH keeps its hardcoded `base=="main"` conditional (closing-keyword-required on integration PRs). A2 fixes the NODE path (GitLab + any Node run-check issue-link) to be base-branch-conditional via ctx.defaultBranch (option c), but does NOT migrate GitHub's bash issue-link/diff-size to Node this slice (out of scope, per design Decision 2).

Consequence (PRE-existing, honestly recorded, NOT introduced by A2): a GitHub consumer whose default branch is NOT `main` (e.g. GitFlow default=develop) would inherit the bash's old behavior — the bash checks literal "main", not the repo's real default branch. For THIS repo (default==main) it is correct.

Follow-up (own slice): unify the GitHub bash issue-link/diff-size over `ctx.defaultBranch` when those two paths migrate to Node (the same uniform-Node-entrypoints direction A2 established for GitLab). Until then, A2's parity table marks this divergence EXPLICITLY rather than faking total parity.

Where: .github/workflows/governance.yml (issue-link bash, base=="main"); brain/scripts/governance/checks/issue-link.mjs (pure evaluator, intact); brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs (Node wrapper, now defaultBranch-conditional). Related: [[sdd/issue-231-a2/kickoff]].
